text:
incident-bot: ALERT: p99 latency spike detected for model-llama-streaming in prod-west. p95 ~1.2s -> 3.8s, p99 ~ 1.9s -> 11.4s in last 3m. Streaming stalls reported (client rebuffer). Possible KV cache pressure. Paging oncall. https://grafana.redwood/alerts/1847501234 :rotating_light:

alice: oncall here, acknowledged. digging in. which customers affected? any traffic surge?

ben: seeing increased eviction rate on kv-cache-hosts (evicts/sec x10). cache utilization 96% and fragmentation metric shows many small entry gaps. prefill_hits dropped, decode-only hits up.

carol: noticed a burst of long-prefill requests from route /chat/stream (large context windows 16k tokens) starting ~1847500500. those prefill calls load big KV snapshots, pushing eviction.

alice: good pickup. is this localized to a specific pool? which hosts serving model-llama-streaming?

ben: affected pool: pool-west-1a (gpu-pool-7). Hosts: infer-7a-1..6. evictions spiking on infer-7a-3 and -4.

dino-bot: deploy-notice: recent rollout of prefill-optimizer v2.1 to pool-west-1a at 1847499000.

carol: that rollout changed prefill behavior to store per-session prefills to kv with smaller chunking. but looks like chunk size decreased and created many small entries -> fragmentation.

alice: impact: customer A (video-chat) reported streaming stalls/seek failures, p99 for that tenant ~14s. flagged premium customers. notify CS?

eve: pinging CS now. I'll include mitigation steps and ETA.

frank: logs from worker infer-7a-3: ```
[1847501168] KVCache::Get miss for key session:abc123:chunk:42
[1847501168] AsyncPrefill enqueue session:abc123 size=1.2MB
[1847501170] Evicting entry session:xyz987 size=800kb due to capacity pressure
[1847501170] Decode step blocked waiting on prefill load (timeout 2000ms)
```

ben: these timeouts add to tail latency when decode waits for prefill. eviction thrash because many small entries mean allocator fragmentation, free memory exists but not contiguous.

alice: triage hypotheses: 1) prefill-optimizer v2.1 decreased chunking -> fragmentation. 2) too-small eviction policy (LRU with strict size rounding). 3) decode path blocking on prefill IO.

carol: real quick mitigations we can do now (low-risk):
- increase kv cache capacity on pool-west-1a (hotfix scaling)
- temporarily disable per-session prefilling for long-context routes (fall back to decode-first)
- bump prefill IO timeouts to avoid long blocking

alice: agree. prioritize: scale cache + disable prefill for /chat/stream for 5-15m and monitor p99. ben, can you trigger scale? carol can you toggle route config?

ben: scaling request submitted to infra autoscaler: increase kv-cache replicas + add 2 slabs to allocator on pool-west-1a. command: ```infractl scale-kv --pool pool-west-1a --add-replicas 2 --add-slabs 2``` ETA ~3m.

carol: toggling route rule now: set prefill=false for route /chat/stream on pool-west-1a. ```routesctl set pool-west-1a /chat/stream prefill=false --reason \"incident 1847501234\"```

alice: also flip prefill-optimizer rollback if we need; can we canary rollback v2.0? dino-bot shows rollout at 1847499000 so it should be easy.

dino-bot: rollout rollback command: ```deployctl rollback prefill-optimizer v2.0 --pool pool-west-1a``` (manual approval required).

ben: scaling is in progress, slabs allocated. I also bumped prefill IO timeout from 2000ms -> 4000ms on the worker config (hotpatch): ```kv-config set --timeout 4000 --host infer-7a-3,4```

eve: CS update: \"We're seeing reduced interruptions for affected customers. Ops is applying mitigations.\" sending follow-up note that root cause investigation ongoing.

frank: after scaling + route toggle, p95 dropped to 1.1s and p99 to ~2.6s within 4m. streaming stalls reports down.

alice: nice. keep rollback as option if fragmentation persists. continue to monitor eviction rate and fragmentation metric.

ben: eviction/sec back to normal for all nodes except infer-7a-4 where a background compaction is running. fragmentation metric expected to converge after compaction.

carol: scheduled compaction on infer-7a-4 finished at 1847501900. reclaimed ~1.4GB contiguous. fragmentation ratio improved 0.78 -> 0.22.

alice: can we make a follow-up action list? I'll own postmortem. items:
- revert prefill-optimizer v2.1 changes that decreased chunk size OR tune chunk thresholds (owner: carol)
- improve allocator to handle many small entries (owner: ben)
notes: prefill vs decode imbalance, KV fragmentation, hotpatch scaling and route toggles used as mitigation
